main_text.p: ut, der apffelbaum/pomus, d'birnbaum[?]/pyrus: quia dicimus der baum/arbor, das einhorn/unicornis, dz[?] Eichhorn/Sciurus: quia dicimus das horn/cornu.
main_text.head: Quid est commune Genus?
main_text.p: Cujus notæ sunt duo articuli: ut, der gevatter/ compater, & die gevatter/ commater, pro quo nos Westphali dicimus, die vadderiche/ & die gemahl[?]/ conjux, der & das theil/ pars, der & das scepter/ sceptrum, die & das e kentnis[?]/ notitia, die & das gifft/ venenum. Hęc communia vulgo appellantur Dubia.
main_text.head: Quid est omne Genus?
main_text.p: Cujus notæ sunt articuli Der/Die/Das: ut, Der/Die/Das fromme.
main_text.head: Quæ Nomina sunt omnis generis?
main_text.p: Adjectiva omnia: sed quædam habent unam terminationem: ut, der kluge mann/ prudens vir, die kluge frawe/ prudens fœmina, das kluge thier/ prudens animal. Cum articuli Der/Die/Das præcedunt, Adjectivum semper definit in e: Quando vero Substan-tivum præcedit, Adjectivum definit in illam literam, quæ antegreditur, & e abjicitur: ut, der mann ist klug/ vir est prudens, die fraw ist klug/ das thier ist klug/ nicht kluge/ die männer seind klug/ die frawen sind klug/ die thiere sind klug/nicht kluge. Excipitur weise/sapiens, quod e retinet, ut differat ab Adjecti-vo weiß/ albus: Et böse/ malus. Nam dicimus der mann ist böse vel böß. Adjectiva numeralia etiam u-nam terminationem habent: ut, drey/ vier/ fünff männer/ drey/ vier/ fünff frawen/ drey/ vier/ fünff thiere.

Quædam Adjectiva habent tres terminationes: ut, ein kluer man/ein kluge frau/ ein kluges thier. Masculinum Genus definit in er/ fœmininum in e/ neutrum in es/ quando ein/ vel mein/ vel o Adjectivo præpo-

page.notes: Smudge over "gemahl" in the source; reading uncertain. "d'birnbaum" and "dz" before Eichhorn are unclear, as is "e kentnis" (the first letter may be "die"). "vadderiche" is printed slightly unclearly. "omnia:(sed" in the source has a bracket-like mark after the colon, transcribed as "omnia: sed". Long s printed as s was normalised to s. Catchword "præpo-" is at the lower right below the last full line. Printed page number is 8.
